adjudication.rationale: In `embeddable-host.js.es6`, `edit()` does `this.set('categoryId', this.get('host.category.id'))`. But the server serializer for `EmbeddableHost` only provides `category_id` (no embedded `category` object), and the embedding payload (`EmbeddingSerializer` with `embed: :ids`) does not show any sideloded `categories` to hydrate `host.category`. Therefore `host.category` can be `null/undefined`, leaving `categoryId` as `null`. On `save()`, `props.category_id` is set from this `categoryId`, and `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` explicitly assigns `uncategorized_category_id` when `category_id.blank?`, causing a silent reassignment to uncategorized.
